title: Tenant recovery key
description: Public HPKE wrapping and independent receipt-verification keys delivered to an enrolled Punar device through the authenticated Smplify enrollment chain. This document contains no private key material.

public_key.description: 32-byte RFC 9180 DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256) public key, base64url without padding.

receipt_signing_public_key.description: 32-byte Ed25519 public key used only to verify escrow receipts, base64url without padding.
